To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PAHs in the Arctic were mainly in the form of low molecular weight PAHs and the distribution of PA, Hs in soil, lichen and reindeer dung was related to the physicochemical properlies.

the distribution of 16 PAHs in the soil, moss and dung samples at Ny-Alesun was characterized and the physicochemical characteristics of PAHs could be used to predict the distribution of PAHSs in the three compartments.

the distribution of PA, Hs in soil, reindeer dung and moss at Ny-Alesun of the Arctic was controlled by physicochemical properties, such as K(OA), K(P), K(OW), p(L)( degrees ), and the proportions of 3-4 and 5-6 rings of PAHs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the distribution and accumulation of PAHs at Ny-Alesun.
the physicochemical property of PAHs as well as the distribution of PAHS in soil, moss, and reindeer dung in Arctic.
the distribution and physicochemical properties in the Arctic, which will help us to understand the distribution and behavior of organic pollutants in the Arctic.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PAHs with higher K(P), K(OA) or K(OW) would be more enriched in the soil and moss than in the dung at Ny-Alesia.
PAHs with high p(L)( degrees ), low K(P), low K(OA) and high K(OW) would accumulate in moss, whereas PAHs with low p(L)( degrees), high K(P), high K(OA)and low K(OW)would accumulate in soil.
the physicochemical property of PAHs is the main driving force for the distribution of PAHS in different compartments of the Arctic ecosystem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Q(SM) is an indicator of the gas/particle distribution, whereas Q(MD) is an indicator for the soil/organism distribution.
the physicochemical property of PAHs can be used for predicting the accumulation and distribution of PAH in the environment.
the PAHs with higher p(L)( degrees ), K(P), K(OA) and K(OW) were more easily accumulated and enriched in soil, moss, and dung, respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the physicochemical parameters of PAHs can be used for predicting the accumulation of PAHs between different compartments.
the physicochemical characteristics of PAHs play a key role in the distribution of PAHS in the environment.
the physicochemical characteristics of PAHs are suitable for charactering the accumulation and distribution of these compounds in the Arctic environment.
